title: bio‐Keras: A Backend‐Agnostic Keras 3 Python Package for Deep Learning on Biological Sequences
content: Biological computing needs the application of the high throughput machine learning approach to biological sequences. DNA, RNA and protein are the building blocks of the biological sequences and to use them in biological deep learning several sequence based tokentization such as one-hot, k-mer encodings, character, k-mer and trainable byte-pair-encoding (BPE) tokenizers, BERT-style masked-language-model, FASTA/FASTQ input and output are needed. Additionally to use them in the biological deep learning, padding-aware Transformer encoders, dilated residual CNNs, bidirectional LSTMs, and a masked language model are needed. Bio-keras fills this gap with the ready to use the tokenizers and the bio-layers for machine and deep learning. Bio-Keras is TensorFlow, JAX and PyTorch backends compatible and data handling depends on the Numpy.
